component.name: Fretwright
component.summary: Design guitars and print 1:1 paper templates

description.p: Fretwright turns a few measurements into accurate, full-size paper templates for building electric guitars and basses: fretboard with fret slots, scale and bridge layout, radius gauges, neck profile and side view, headstock with tuner holes, and the body with neck pocket and pickup routes.

ul.li: Single scale and fanned frets (multiscale), 4 to 12 strings, zero fret, compensation
Presets for classic bolt-on, single-cut, superstrat, 7-string multiscale and basses
Print on A4, Letter, A3 or Tabloid with a calibration ruler and alignment marks
Export SVG and DXF at 1:1 for laser cutters and CNC
Plain-language checks that explain what to change

screenshot.caption: Designing a guitar with a live 1:1 preview

description.p: First preview: eight templates, PDF/SVG/DXF export, presets for guitars and basses.
